About Birlasoft:  

Birlasoft, a powerhouse where domain expertise, enterprise solutions, and digital technologies converge to redefine business processes. We take pride in our consultative and design thinking approach, driving societal progress by enabling our customers to run businesses with unmatched efficiency and innovation. As part of the CK Birla Group, a multibillion\-dollar enterprise, we boast a 12,500\+ professional team committed to upholding the Group's 162\-year legacy. Our core values prioritize Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiatives, along with Corporate Sustainable Responsibility (CSR) activities, demonstrating our dedication to building inclusive and sustainable communities. Join us in shaping a future where technology seamlessly aligns with purpose.

  

Job Description: Scrum Master with DevSecOps expertise

  

Key Responsibilities  

* 20–25% Team Oversight \& Coordination: Provide team oversight and coordination, ensuring alignment, timely delivery, effective resource utilization, and adherence to project objectives.
* Agile \& JIRA: Manage JIRA in line with Agile practices, including backlog management, sprint planning, refinement, progress tracking, sprint reviews, and governance.
* Proactive Approach: Proactively identify risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities and drive them through to resolution.
* Strong Technical Expertise: Provide technical support across DevSecOps domains, ensuring operational excellence, SLA compliance, zero P1 incidents, proactive issue resolution, and continuous service improvement.
* DevSecOps Platform Engineering: Design, implement, and govern enterprise DevSecOps platforms leveraging GitHub Enterprise, GHAS, GitHub Copilot Governance, GitHub Actions, SonarQube, Artifact Management, Terraform, Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and Microsoft Entra B2B/B2C/External Identities.
* Team Coordination: Act as the primary liaison between the Product Owner and the DevSecOps team to ensure effective collaboration, delivery, and operational support.
* Chapter Time – Knowledge \& Practice Sharing (10%): Dedicate 10% of capacity to knowledge sharing, best practices, standardization, technical awareness, and common engineering practices.
* Value\-Added Contribution: Drive DevSecOps standardization, automation, governance, and platform optimization, with a focus on improving security, developer experience, efficiency, scalability, quality, and operational effectiveness.
* Communication \& Stakeholder Management: Demonstrate strong communication, stakeholder engagement, documentation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and business audiences.

title: AWM Management- Product Management- Associate- Bengaluru
description:
**Our Impact**


The Private Bank is a business unit of the Asset and Wealth Management Division (AWM) that provides tailored lending and banking products, such as bank loans, mortgages, deposits and margin financing, to high\-net\-worth clients of the firm’s global Wealth Management businesses. This role is on the Private Bank Product Management Team, which defines and executes the product strategy across the Private Bank business. We drive the design, development and launch of new Private Bank lending and deposit products and services, collaborating with a network of cross\-divisional stakeholders.

  

**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**


* Own ideation, design, product development, and innovate on new product concepts through deeply understanding client needs, business objectives, and competitive dynamics; delivering valuable products and solutions to our clients.
* Become a subject matter expert understanding different product types, regulatory landscape, competitive landscape and technology platforms and solutions.
* Collaborate and prioritize product delivery with cross\-functional teams (product, technology and operations, L\&C etc.) setting clear goals, milestones and phased delivery of product.
* Support large\-scale projects by leading cross\-divisional working groups and driving high quality deliverables, establishing and managing project timelines and developing rigorous documentation, and drafting executive updates.
* Participate in providing strategic direction and vision for Private bank product portfolio and new product launches based on your domain expertise and deep understanding of client needs and goals.
* Contribute to identifying and fostering a strong product culture and delivery excellence by implementing product best practices and agile ceremonies.
  

**Qualifications**


* Masters in Business Administration or equivalent qualification with 4\+ years of product management experience
* 4\+ years of product management experience building and launching successful digital products. Prior experience in financial services, lending and banking preferred.
* Proven track record of managing the end\-to\-end product development lifecycle for complex, large\-scale initiatives (discovery, initiation, development, testing, iteration).
* Experience working in agile/scrum teams (including JIRA proficiency).
* Demonstrate solid organizational and project management skills, including ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects, manage complex operational processes, deadlines and work streams.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, as well as strong organizational and interpersonal skills

title: Scrum Master - S P
description:
Required Skills:
* Scrum Master
* Agile Methodologies
* Agile Tools
* Agile Metrics
* Stakeholder Management
* Release Planning
* Agile Coaching

  
Nice to Have:
* DevOps \& CI/CD
* Cloud \& AI/ML Programs
* Agile Certifications

  
Qualification \| Graduate Experience (in years) \| 8 Job Description \| We are seeking an experienced and results\-driven Scrum Master to lead Agile teams in delivering high\-quality products and solutions. The Scrum Master will serve as a servant leader and Agile coach, ensuring Scrum principles and practices are effectively implemented while fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and accountability Key Responsibilities Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement sessions. Coach and mentor teams on Agile principles, Scrum practices, and continuous improvement. Partner with Product Owners to ensure backlog readiness, prioritization, and alignment with business objectives. Remove impediments and proactively address risks that impact team productivity and delivery. Monitor sprint progress, team velocity, and Agile metrics to drive performance improvements. Foster collaboration among cross\-functional teams, stakeholders, and leadership. Support release planning and dependency management across multiple teams. Promote transparency through effective communication of progress, risks, and outcomes. Drive Agile maturity and adoption across the organization. Facilitate conflict resolution and encourage a culture of teamwork and accountability. Metrics \& Reporting Track and analyze Agile metrics such as: Velocity Burn\-down/Burn\-up Charts Lead Time Cycle Time Sprint Predictability Release Readiness Provide actionable insights to improve team effectiveness and delivery outcomes. Skill Set Required \| Agile \& Scrum Expertise Strong expertise in Agile methodologies including Scrum, Kanban, Lean, and SAFe. Proven experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and driving Agile best practices. Ability to coach teams, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile principles and delivery excellence. Experience managing multiple Agile teams in a complex enterprise environment. Delivery \& Program Management Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). Experience managing dependencies, risks, issues, and release planning across cross\-functional teams. Ability to drive predictable delivery and improve team performance through Agile metrics. Experience supporting Product, Engineering, Data, Cloud, or Platform teams. Stakeholder Management Excellent communication and facilitation skills. Strong ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations. Experience working with senior leadership to communicate delivery status, risks, and mitigation plans. Proven conflict resolution and negotiation capabilities. Agile Tools \& Metrics Hands\-on experience with: Jira Azure DevOps Confluence Miro Rally (preferred) Expertise in Agile reporting and metrics: Velocity Burn\-down/Burn\-up Charts Cycle Time Lead Time Sprint Predictability Team Capacity Planning Leadership \& Coaching Strong servant leadership mindset. Ability to mentor and develop high\-performing Agile teams. Experience driving Agile transformation and continuous improvement initiatives. Excellent facilitation, coaching, and team\-building skills. Preferred Skills Experience working in Data Platforms, Cloud Platforms, AI/ML, or Digital Transformation programs. Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD practices, and Engineering Excellence frameworks. Experience in enterprise\-scale Agile delivery environments. Familiarity with Product Operating Models and value\-stream\-based delivery. Certifications Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM) SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) or SAFe Agilist (Preferred) PMI\-ACP (Preferred) Agile Coaching Certification (Nice to Have)
